notes.title: Ironseed Update
notes.content:
1.1.8
=====
* Tweaks to bot production rates
* Conversation keyword drop list on Easy difficulty

Highly recommended to go to the Medical cubeface and Options and turn on Easy difficulty.  This will display a droplist of possible keywords.  Knowing all keywords is a bit of a spoiler but the greater concern is new players missing the story not knowing what to ask about.  If you just care about the story, Easy mode is the way to go.  Keywords will be adjusted based on various events.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38680242/126418b023227e58004f504c44fc8bf9112b475b.png[/img]

tags.feature: * Conversation keyword drop list on Easy difficulty

notes.title: Ironseed Update
notes.content:
1.1.7
=====
* Low Res (Classic) aka, Extra Chunky Mode, and High Res (xBRZ), aka Smooth Mode, option in Options Display, defaults to off (Smooth/xBRZ)
* Fix solar system regenerating when returning to bridge every single time
* Fix Approach Planet flag not resetting properly causing constant camera movement returning to bridge
* Fix gaseous planets anomalies not showing high enough above the surface
* Adjust shield power usage (it was 8x higher in non-Combat)
* Adjust overall shield power usage (it was 10x higher than expected and making shields worthless)
